You learn to slip past creatures that see through darkvision. While in darkness, any creature relying on darkvision cannot see you there.

Additionally, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack while hidden, you can force it to make a Dexterity saving throw against your tech save DC; on a failure, its speed drops to 0 until the end of your next turn. You can use this three times, gaining one more use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all uses on finishing a short or long rest.
